# The constraint operations of ASTM F3548-21 as the pinned utm.yaml
# declares them: operationId, method, path, the scopes of its security
# requirement, the success status. Extracted (not written by hand) from
#   spec_url = https://raw.githubusercontent.com/interuss/astm-utm-protocol/1d3d8fbe75414e23d7e19ce35955770bea5e413f/utm.yaml
#   spec_sha256 = 63482b2a665ecd836b269028a13b19adfde7a5c32b01301c168d87ca3313dd15
# (uspace-core v1.3.0 f3548/SOURCE) with python3 + PyYAML:
#   for each path below, for each operation: operationId, method,
#   path, the security scopes joined by ",", the 2xx codes joined by ","
# paths_test.go holds internal/dss.Operations equal to these lines and
# the two pins above equal to uspace-core's f3548/SOURCE.
getConstraintReference GET /dss/v1/constraint_references/{entityid} utm.constraint_management,utm.constraint_processing 200
createConstraintReference PUT /dss/v1/constraint_references/{entityid} utm.constraint_management 201
updateConstraintReference PUT /dss/v1/constraint_references/{entityid}/{ovn} utm.constraint_management 200
deleteConstraintReference DELETE /dss/v1/constraint_references/{entityid}/{ovn} utm.constraint_management 200
notifyConstraintDetailsChanged POST /uss/v1/constraints utm.constraint_management 204
getConstraintDetails GET /uss/v1/constraints/{entityid} utm.constraint_processing 200
